rejected.reason: The Barcelona property result showed 2 adults/1 room and nightly pricing, but Hotel Best Aranea had no explicit 1-star class in the returned evidence; it was rejected rather than inferred.

A Hostal Sant Antoni result identified a 1.0-star Barcelona property and a nightly price, but did not state two adults/one room in the evidence. Occupancy cannot be inferred from the query, so it was rejected.

Trip.com returned 1-star Barcelona properties with explicit occupancy, including Hotel Cantón (2 adults/1 child) and Arte Suites/Hotel Casa Trafalgar (2 adults/1 room), but each price was a 'starting from' rate. City-level 1-star averages were also returned, but generic averages are outside this property-basket experiment. All were rejected.
The Agoda-restricted search returned documentation and unrelated results, not a named Barcelona 1-star property with explicit two-adult/one-room non-from nightly pricing and a date/window.
